name: angularjs-micronaut-kit
description: Test-first sprint workflow for a repository with an AngularJS 1.x UI in av-ui/ and a Micronaut 4 / Java 21 API in av-service/: planner, generator and evaluator agents, procedure skills for endpoints, persistence, pages, forms and accessibility, a protect-files hook, and a setup skill that copies rules, CLAUDE.md, permissions and Git hooks into the repository.
